how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/bands.png (24x16 truecolour PNG, three vertical colour bands, written by hand with zlib), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: The same 68 bytes under Apple's dynamic UTI for the same private type. dyn. identifiers are a base-encoded legacy OSType/MIME/extension and are legal but opaque; decoding them belongs in rclip-core (PLAN.md 4.1), not here, so the capture carries the identifier verbatim.
